title: World-class
subtitle: 「世界級／頂尖／卓越／達到國際標準」，究竟是哪一種 world-class？
description: 「世界級／頂尖／卓越／達到國際標準」，究竟是哪一種 world-class？

words.meaning: 卓越的；異常出色的；非凡的
words.note: 使用者提供。exceptional 強調品質、能力或表現明顯高於一般水平。它比 world-class 少一點『國際頂尖』比較框架，但在很多高品質語境中是自然近義詞。
words.example: The university is known for its exceptional research facilities.

exercises.original: The hospital provides world-class care in several specialist areas.
exercises.zh: 這家醫院在數個專科領域提供卓越照護。
exercises.upgrade: exceptional · 卓越的；異常出色的；非凡的

options.explanation: care + several specialist areas focuses on outstanding quality rather than an explicit global ranking.
強調屬於最高層級或最高品質類別。 但本題的具體線索是 outstanding quality of care；這句真正要表達的是「卓越、遠高於一般」。因此 top-tier 雖與 world-class 接近，排名方式、認可來源、競爭框架或語域並不最吻合。

falseSynonyms.zh: exceptional 強調遠高於一般水平；world-class 還多一層可與全球最佳者相比的意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The service was exceptional. The facility is described as world-class.

falseSynonyms.zh: top-tier 強調層級／分類；world-class 更強調全球最高水準。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The firm works with top-tier suppliers. The institute aims to be world-class.

falseSynonyms.zh: of international standard 只要求達到國際標準，未必是全球最頂尖。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The venue is of international standard. The centre claims to offer world-class facilities.

falseSynonyms.zh: elite 通常指人、團隊、學校或少數頂尖群體；不能自然修飾所有物件。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is an elite athlete. The laboratory has world-class equipment.

falseSynonyms.zh: globally recognised 強調聲譽／認可；被全球認識不一定等於品質世界第一。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The brand is globally recognised. Its engineering is world-class.

falseSynonyms.zh: internationally competitive 強調能在全球競爭，不一定表示品質達到絕對最高水平。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The sector is internationally competitive. The facility is world-class.

falseSynonyms.zh: best-in-class 需要一個明確類別／比較組；world-class 可更廣泛地讚揚品質。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The product has best-in-class battery life. The university has world-class facilities.

falseSynonyms.zh: world-famous 表示全球知名；知名度和品質不是同一概念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The landmark is world-famous. The hospital provides world-class care.
